# robinhood-chain-traders

> A framework and runnable fleet of autonomous agents that trade Robinhood Chain memecoins and watch Stock Token premium/discount: real quotes, real risk caps, live P&L.

robinhood-chain-traders is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
